images.title: Move the point until one digit is left
images.purpose: Shows 5900 written as 5.9 × 10³ by moving the decimal point 3 places to the left.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large number in the middle with three hop arrows above it and the result below.
images.exact_structure: In large type in the centre, the digits 5 9 0 0 with a reddish purple (#CC79A7) decimal point drawn between the 5 and the 9, and one small hollow circle with a thin dark outline after the last 0, marking where the point started. Exactly three equal amber (#E69F00) curved hop arrows above the digits go from the hollow circle leftward, one place each, ending at the purple point between the 5 and the 9; one label 3 moves above them. Below the digits, in teal (#0072B2), the label 5.9 × 10³. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Scientific notation keeps one nonzero digit before the point and counts the moves as the power of 10.
images.description: Shows 5900 written as 5.9 × 10³ by moving the decimal point 3 places to the left.

image_decisions.why: Watching the point hop three places shows where the exponent of 10 comes from.
